show.description: When kind-hearted schoolteacher Vedika unknowingly marries Shaurya Khurana, the arrogant and spoiled heir of a billionaire empire, she expects a normal life but ends up at the center of a storm. As family secrets unravel and Shaurya’s past clashes with Vedika’s values, love is tested in a world where wealth hides wounds, and the truth could break them or bring them closer than ever. Watch Now!
